donor_structure: (a) Saturation: enzyme turnover rate v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]); marginal value of additional catalytic capacity decreases hyperbolically in substrate and vanishes at saturation, so capacity investment is governed by the saturation knee. (b) Channeling: direct enzyme-to-enzyme metabolite transfer (dedicated lane, built once) trades against free diffusion (per-use transport cost, no build cost); the trade is decided by flux intensity and locality. (c) Enzyme investment: cells regulate enzyme levels against anticipated flux; over-investment past the saturation point buys nothing.
target_structure: A_T05 at R7: amortization identity with shared modules (2-level). Ladder already owns the R5 renewal-reward form (PARENT_SUFFICIENT, verified). The R7 two-level clause (module shared between levels, cross-level charging) is unclaimed.
mapping: saturation knee (marginal per-use value -> 0) <-> diminishing per-use saving of a module at high use intensity H_eff
Vmax <-> maximum service rate of one module instance
Km (half-saturation constant) <-> use intensity at which per-use marginal saving halves
channeling build cost (dedicated lane) <-> C_build of a shared module
diffusion per-use cost <-> per-use charge of unshared/inline execution
enzyme-level regulation against anticipated flux <-> promotion decision (ties to A_T11, see A6-R1/A6-R2)
